plan.planning_summary: This control axis tests whether expanding the thickness initialization perturbation around a known good candidate improves convergence to a deeper optimum in the 22-layer ZnS/Al2O3 design space. The prior knowledge is that quarter-wave-inspired stacks with gradient refinement can trap in shallow local maxima when initialization bounds are too tight. This route draws from recalled thin-film design practice: broader initialization sampling followed by local refinement explores basin topology more thoroughly.

routes.title: Expanded Perturbation Refinement on 22-Layer ZnS/Al2O3 IR Dual-Band Filter
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Increasing thickness initialization perturbation from ±10 nm to ±50 nm around the previous best candidate will yield a higher best_target_score by escaping shallow local maxima in the 22-layer optimization landscape.
routes.design_principle: Gradient-based thickness optimization on multilayer stacks can converge to local rather than global optima when initialization is too close to a prior solution. Broader perturbation samples the basin more thoroughly, allowing the optimizer to find steeper descent paths that tight initialization misses.
routes.proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | ZnS | Al2O3 | Daimon-20 substrate (22 coating layers)
design_variables: All 22 layer thicknesses initialized with ±50 nm perturbation around the iteration_12 best candidate, then optimized via bounded quasi-Newton gradient descent
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 3250-3350 nm band
Maximize mean transmittance in 4200-4300 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 2500-3100 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 4450-5000 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Total layer count fixed at 22 (within 24-layer limit)
All materials are conventional depositable IR dielectrics
Individual layer thicknesses should remain within 50-1500 nm for deposition feasibility
theory_basis: Recalled thin-film design practice: gradient-based optimizers on multilayer stacks benefit from broader initialization to escape local maxima
Recalled IR material behavior: ZnS provides high refractive index contrast against Al2O3 in the 2.5-5 μm range
Recalled design pattern: alternating high/low index pairs create stopbands; deviations from quarter-wave enable multiple passbands
Recalled optimization heuristic: ±50 nm perturbation is large enough to sample basin topology but small enough to remain in feasible manufacturing region
expected_advantages: Better exploration of thickness space around the known good solution
Potential to find higher best_target_score than iteration_12's 0.9163
Maintains material pair that already compiled successfully
Tests whether prior result was limited by initialization tightness rather than material choice
known_risks: Uncertain whether ±50 nm perturbation is optimal magnitude -- could be too large (escaping useful basin) or too small (still trapped). Literature search on IR filter optimization basin sizes would clarify.

Uncertain whether ZnS/Al2O3 is the best material pair for this specific dual-band requirement -- other pairs like ZnS/MgF2 or Si/SiO2 might offer better index contrast in IR, but MgF2 had material_data issues in iteration_04.
Daimon-20 substrate refractive index dispersion in 2.5-5 μm range is recalled but not verified against registry data.
The 22-layer count was chosen heuristically; a different layer count might achieve better performance but would require a separate route.
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer planar multilayer thin film stack on CaF2 (Daimon-20) substrate with air incidence. Stack sequence: ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat), ZnS, Al2O3 (Kischkat) (22 coating layers total). Initialize all 22 layer thicknesses with random perturbation of ±50 nm around the iteration_12 best candidate thicknesses [967.0, 625.0, 727.5, 670.5, 446.0, 1179.0, 372.5, 588.5, 873.0, 492.0, 472.0, 1135.0, 328.0, 448.0, 854.0, 441.5, 832.0, 1240.5, 932.5, 391.5, 818.5, 871.5] nm, then optimize using bounded quasi-Newton gradient descent with thickness bounds 50-1500 nm. Evaluate coherent transfer matrix method in frequency domain. Score four independent mean-transmittance targets: maximize in 3250-3350 nm, maximize in 4200-4300 nm, minimize in 2500-3100 nm, minimize in 4450-5000 nm. No metal layers. Materials resolved from registry: zns, Al2O3 (Kischkat), CaF2 (Daimon-20) substrate.
routes.revision_reason: Replaced ambiguous CaF2 substrate name with Daimon-20 dataset identifier per registry resolution requirement; expanded thickness initialization perturbation from ±10 nm to ±50 nm around iteration_12 best candidate to test basin topology and prevent trapping in shallow local maxima.

selector_prompt.system:
You are the internal material-dataset selector inside a scientific TMM
harness. This is not route planning and you must not redesign the route.
Return exactly one JSON object and no markdown:
{"selections":[{"request_id":"material_01","selected_rank":1,"provider":"rii_sqlite","dataset_id":562,"reason":"..."}]}

The user question is authoritative. Each request contains candidates already
retrieved from the local MaterialRegistry and sorted by three equal physical
metrics: target-band coverage, n/k completeness, and sampling density. Rank 1
is the most physically reliable candidate; lower rank means less reliable.
Choose exactly one candidate from the supplied list for every request. Never
invent, rename, or edit a provider or dataset_id. The selected_rank must point
to the selected array element, and provider/dataset_id must copy that element.

Material identity, stoichiometry, explicit material state/preparation, and an
explicit requested source are hard constraints. A candidate with
formula_exact=false or semantic_match=same_element_family is not an allowed
substitute for a formula request. SiO is not SiO2, even if the SiO2 candidate
has better physical coverage. When several candidates satisfy the hard
constraints, select the highest-ranked one (usually rank 1). If no candidate
satisfies them, return selected_rank:null, provider:null, dataset_id:null and
reason:"needs_confirmation" for that request.
